[operator-attested] Live measurement workflow_dispatch run COMPLETE.

Run: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/30983268038 (structured-output-baseline.yml, ref=main, max_calls=120)
All 3 provider arms: SUCCESS. Raw replies (single_shot + agentic_transcript, current+sentinel) + score_table.json uploaded as artifacts per arm.

Before/after score table (n=20 per cell; "ok" = parse success under new selection+sentinel parser; layout = raw-output class counts):

| provider  | variant (directive) | ok/n  | prose | fenced | multi_object |
|-----------|---------------------|-------|-------|--------|--------------|
| anthropic | current (before)    | 8/20  | 3     | 13     | 4            |
| anthropic | sentinel (after)    | 11/20 | 20    | 0      | 0            |
| bedrock   | current (before)    | 9/20  | 6     | 12     | 2            |
| bedrock   | sentinel (after)    | 11/20 | 20    | 0      | 0            |
| openai    | current (before)    | 18/20 | 20    | 0      | 0            |
| openai    | sentinel (after)    | 19/20 | 20    | 0      | 0            |

Key finding (confirms the epic thesis): the sentinel directive collapses raw-output layout to
100% prose (fenced/multi_object -> 0 on anthropic & bedrock, the arms that previously emitted
code fences) and raises parse success on every arm. This is the measured before/after
distribution the sentinel (18ae) and capability-rows (4ca2) stories consume. Each arm records
the other two providers as "unmeasured" (per-arm secret scoping), so the union across the 3
arms covers all cells.
